subject.title: feat(model): support one-turn chat model override

question: Should one-turn model overrides ship first as inline `/model <provider/model> <message>` chat syntax, or wait for the explicit `sessions.patch` or `chat.send` API contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565?
rationale: The branch chooses inline Gateway parsing, while the canonical request affects public protocol shape, authorization, response metadata, session state, and provider/auth routing.

options.title: Define the API first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and align implementation to that contract.

options.title: Accept inline syntax with repairs
options.body: Allow inline `/model` as the product surface, but require authorization, auth/session isolation fixes, docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Reject inline syntax
options.body: Close or rework this PR so one-turn overrides only ship through a future explicit chat or session API.

recommendation.title: Define the API first
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and align implementation to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across directive handling, model/session routing, and the public contract this PR would define.
